blind.description: A square architectural roof skylight or lantern. It consists of a low brown wooden curb/box base with corner posts, topped by a low-pitched pyramidal framework made of dark grey lead or metal. The metal frame features eight radiating ribs (four hip ribs running to the corners and four center ribs running to each side) holding dark greenish glass panes. At the apex is a square metal cap topped with a spherical metal ball finial. Surfaces are smooth, solid, and stylised with clean hand-painted style shading.
blind.from_above: A square structure with an eight-spoke radial pattern of metal mullions meeting at a central square hub with a ball finial, dividing the glass into eight triangular panels inside an outer square metal and wood border.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.5 to 2 feet tall (reaching below the figure's knee) and approximately 3 to 3.5 feet wide across both horizontal dimensions.

notes: Height is somewhat taller than catalog spec (2.74 ft vs 1.3 ft) due to curb and ball finial, but reads cleanly as intended
